message:
As the clouds roll in and the wind starts to whisper, I’m reminded of those cozy afternoons spent hunkered down with a cup of tea and a good book. While we can’t control the weather, having a little plan in place can turn a stormy day into a snug family event. I came across a helpful resource that offers some practical tips for staying safe and dry during floods. It’s all about making sure you have what you need, so you can focus on enjoying the moment rather than worrying about it. 

What’s your favorite way to make a stormy day feel a bit more special?
